title: Bitwarden CLI connector configuration
description: Points the bw CLI at a server and optionally holds an API key for unattended login. Reading secrets still needs the vault unlocked with the master password, which is never stored.

serverUrl.description: Bitwarden server base URL. Health is checked at /alive.

email.description: Account e-mail, kept for display only.

clientId.description: API key client id, used for unattended `bw login --apikey`.

clientSecret.description: API key client secret. Passed to the CLI as an environment variable, never as an argument.
